name: Hollow Gate Anchor
loreTies: A stationary living keystone that lets Hollow waves keep returning until the active Titan breaks the wound itself.
Acts as a priority objective; spawns minor Hollow until destroyed.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Gate Anchor is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into elite battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Gate Anchor formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Titan, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Acts as a priority objective; spawns minor Hollow until destroyed. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A stationary living keystone that lets Hollow waves keep returning until the active Titan breaks the wound itself.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Gate Anchor can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Gate Anchor visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses obsidian gate-stone torso rooted into battlefield, incomplete arms, white fracture core, broken arch crown. while its abilities — Breach Pulse, Spawn Wretches, Anchor the Wound — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Titan.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
